mentions.name: Downread
mentions.description: An advanced RSS reader that pushes beyond typical feed reading: it supports podcasts with background playback, queuing, and video streaming, and is adding posting and commenting within the reader built on rss.chat and the webmention protocol. Mobile apps are also planned.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on http://downread.com/, making it an advanced RSS reader. 
I am trying to push the boundaries of what an RSS reader can do. Just added podcast capabilities, complete with background play, queuing and video streaming.
